caseName: Commercial Communications, Inc. v. Public Utilities Commission of California
caseNameFull: COMMERCIAL COMMUNICATIONS, INC., Et Al. v. PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF CALIFORNIA Et Al.
attorneys: Frederick M. Rowe for appellants., J. Thomason Phelps for the Public Utilities Commission of California, and Arthur T, George, Eugene M. Prince and Francis R. Kirkham for the Pacific Telephone & Telegraph Co., appellées.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to dismiss, are granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Clark, Mr. Justice Harlan and Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
